morning_judgment: The Hormuz file has moved from strike-pause rhetoric toward a concrete but still contested reopening effort: Iran and Oman are discussing passage mechanics, yet no shared settlement or restored traffic is established. The access-governance judgment remains active, while the cross-theater capacity and Indo-Pacific visibility tests remain provisional.
